headline.purpose: Item-screen h1 (an assumption, a source). The largest type in the app.

title.purpose: Sheet title: the h1 of a list screen, followed by a faint count.

reading.purpose: Passages, quotes and empty-state text people read.

body.purpose: The UI: rows, buttons, menus, forms.

meta.purpose: Secondary lines, chips, hints, errors, group headings.

label.purpose: Counts, panel section labels, captions, keyboard hints.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Resting: panels, sheets, the pill, callouts, the current segmented item. Dark: 0 2px 5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 0 0 0.5px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08).

shadows.name: shadow-2
shadows.purpose: Lifted: menus, dialogs, toasts, panels as phone drawers. Dark: 0 10px 28px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55), 0 0 0 0.5px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1).

shadows.name: shadow-flash
shadows.purpose: The search palette alone, for a moment, when left untouched for three seconds; it fades back to shadow-2. Dark: 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85), 0 0 0 7px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.3), 0 0 90px 28px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35).

shadows.name: shadow-paper
shadows.purpose: The preview frame for an uploaded original. Dark: 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08), 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing curve for every transition and entrance.

motion.name: dur-1
motion.purpose: Small state changes: hovers, carets, menus (menus close in 100ms).

motion.name: dur-3
motion.purpose: Panels, the inspector, the canvas and the pill.

components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 58px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--panel, #fff); color: var(--muted, #555); box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08), 0 0 0 0.5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12); cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill > svg:first-child { color: var(--text, #1e1e1e); } .ds-visually-hidden { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill:hover { background: var(--hover, #f2f2f2); color: var(--text, #1e1e1e); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #5a53e8); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
One floating panel carries the product's whole story, Idea, Evidence, Exploration and Story in that order, and the content takes the rest of the canvas. Studio is a tool-maker's workspace: a light grey canvas (near-black in dark), white panels with 12px corners floating 10px in from the window edge, hairline rules, and a soft two-layer shadow. There is no top bar, no persistent rail beside the panel, and no app-level tab strip. One screen shows at a time, links are real links, and the browser owns tabs.

The system is dense and quiet. The UI runs at 12px in Inter; text people actually read (passages, quotes, Markdown) steps up to 13 to 13.5px. Hierarchy comes from weight (600) and grey steps rather than size, and nothing in the app is larger than 20px except the overview's intro. Indigo is the only chromatic voice in the chrome, reserved for selection, focus, primary commits and pointing at evidence. Status always pairs a small shaped mark with a word.

The panel can hide (a button or Ctrl/Cmd+\). The canvas widens in a single 200ms motion and a small floating pill with the mark takes its place. Item screens (a Story, a source) add a 272px inspector floating on the right, which hides and returns the same way: a button in its head or Shift+Ctrl/Cmd+\, and a square at the top-right inset in its place. A Story page is not part of Studio: it follows the product's own Story style (the company's design system or a house style) inside a sandboxed frame. On the Story, focus mode (F) hides both panels so the page has the window, and Esc or F brings them back.
keyCharacteristics: A 264px floating left panel and 272px floating inspector around one scrolling canvas (content max 900px).
White-on-grey tonal layering; the shadow's 0.5px ring stands in for a panel border.
Inter at 11 to 15px for the UI, 20px as the ceiling outside the overview's intro; 600 is the heading weight.
Indigo for selection, focus, primary commits and evidence only.
Lucide icons at 12 or 14px with a 1.75 stroke, through one glyph map.
Light and dark are both first-class and resolved before first paint.

rules.name: The Earned Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo means "selected, focused, commit, or evidence". It never decorates, never fills a header, and never marks a category. A view carries at most one accent-filled button, usually the commit in a form or dialog or the first-creation action in an empty state. A populated sheet header's create action stays a default button.

rules.name: The Mark And Word Rule
rules.body: Status is a 7px mark followed by a word, both in the status colour. The mark's shape carries the state on its own: a filled dot for positive, a ring for attention, a small diamond for negative, a spinning open arc for progress and a faint ring for neutral. Colour is never the only signal.

rules.name: The Two Schemes Rule
rules.body: Every colour token has a light and a dark value, and colour-mixed tokens are re-derived inside each theme scope. A new colour lands in both sets or it doesn't land.

rules.name: The Twenty Pixel Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the app exceeds 20px. When something needs more emphasis, raise its weight or darken its grey.

rules.name: The Read Up Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays at 12px. Anything a person reads as content (passages, quotes, prose) steps up to 13 to 13.5px with a looser line height and a 68ch measure.

rules.name: The One Scroller Rule
rules.body: The canvas scrolls the page. Only the panel's context slot, the inspector body, menus and dialogs scroll on their own.

rules.name: The Float Inset Rule
rules.body: Floating surfaces sit exactly 10px from the window edge. On phones they go flush, never partially inset.

rules.name: The Two Heights Rule
rules.body: A surface either rests in the layout or lifts above it. Use no other shadow values, and use no offset or coloured shadows. The one exception is the search palette's passing flash.

dos: **Do** take every colour, size, radius, shadow, duration and layer from the token file. Screen stylesheets compose tokens and add layout only.
**Do** keep controls at 24px or 28px, and reserve 32px for the floating pill and its square.
**Do** draw icons through the glyph map: lucide at 12px or 14px, 1.75 stroke, faint or muted at rest.
**Do** pair every status with its shaped 7px mark and a word.

**Do** animate with the one ease (`cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)`) at 120ms for small state changes, 160ms for toasts and dialogs, and 200ms for panels, the inspector and the canvas. Honour reduced motion.
**Do** show focus with the 2px accent outline at 1px offset. Rows inside sheets inset it (-2px).
**Do** keep Story pages out of Studio: the Story guidance and house styles never copy the app's tokens.
donts: **Don't** add a top bar, a second rail, an app-level tab strip or extra drawers beside the panel. On phones the panel itself is the drawer.
**Don't** set app type above 20px, and don't add a display face to the app.
**Don't** use the accent for decoration, category colour, large fills or more than one filled button in a view.
**Don't** use shadows outside the resting, lifted and paper set, including hard offset, coloured or glow shadows.
**Don't** add small uppercase labels above titles. Section labels are 11px sentence case in faint 500.
**Don't** use text characters or emoji as icons. Every icon is a lucide glyph.
